correctness.rationale: The exact charge-matching decomposition expresses every endpoint-zero nodal vector as signed interior-block indicators with total absolute coefficients precisely half its nodal variation. Repeated Bernstein images of each block remain unimodal and nonnegative, with variation equal twice the maximum. The absorbing-binomial chain dominates each block by full-interior survival, symmetric unimodality centers that maximum at 1/2, and the full plateau attains it. Strictness for proper blocks yields nodal extremizer rigidity. The rational matrix formula, quadratic eigenfunction comparison, Perron asymptotic, and strict submultiplicativity follow with all n>=2 and r>=1 cases handled. Exact-fraction finite tests and random numerical tests passed but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: For unrestricted BV, classical variation-diminishing inequalities have the sharp constant one due to reproduced affine functions; they fail to quantify stability on endpoint-matched perturbations. The new exact norm gives a natural strict finite-time attenuation factor with a direct absorption-survival interpretation, uniqueness of worst data and sharp exponential behavior at every degree. This is a complete norm computation and a useful quantitative stability benchmark for standard approximation iterations, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
